newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner wins NOK 170 mln ferry deal.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner wins NOK 170 mln ferry deal.

text.p: Anglo-Norwegian construction and engineering group Kvaerner ASA said on Thursday its Kvaerner Fjellstrand shipyard in Norway had won a contract to build a high speed passenger and car ferry catamaran from Express Ferries Ltd.
The deal was worth around 170 million crowns, Kvaerner said in a statement.
The 60 metre JumboCat will be used between Helsinki in Finland and Tallinn in Estonia. It was due for delivery in April, 1998.
The aluminium vessel will carry up to 430 passengers and 52 cars. It is the second such ferry to be built at the yard.
Kvaerner said the contract included an option for a second vessel for delivery in spring, 1999.
